note: The footnote line, as one canonical string, read by BOTH renderers' tests.
The PDF pack renders it in Python and the phone board renders it in JavaScript. §33 forbids
forge/ and serve/ sharing code, so they cannot share the function — they share this file, the
same arrangement as package-vectors.json. What it forbids is the two disagreeing.
⚠️ They already did, in three ways, while a reading of the PDF alone suggested they agreed:
the PDF printed no count at all and no '#', and it put LOB last while the HTML put it first.
A board with SH total 2 across slots 2 and 9b came out 'SH: 2, 9b' from one and
THE FORMAT: each carrier is '<count> #<slot>', carriers joined by ', ', terms in
FOOTNOTE_COLUMNS order, LOB last, all joined by three spaces.
⚠️ The count is printed even when it is one. A format that shows it only sometimes is ambiguous
again — the same trap as a slot letter that appears only when the slot is shared, which made the
old format unambiguous by accident rather than by design.
⚠️ The count is not decoration. 'SH: 2' in the old format meant a sacrifice in slot 2 and could
not say two sacrifices in one slot. Measured over the gated pool: 4,040 of 100,742
directions carry at least one row with more than one of the same term — 4.01%, and 8.31% in the
1920s where the pool is thinnest. Those boards are unsolvable: the row identity
PA = AB + BB + HBP + SF + SH + CI has no other route to the value, and every total still
balances, which is why no validation layer sees it.

cases.name: one term, one carrier, one occurrence
cases.why: the count prints even at one; without that rule this line and the next are indistinguishable

cases.name: one carrier with two of the same term
cases.why: the case the old format could not express at all, and the reason for the change

cases.name: two carriers, one each
cases.why: reads as two ones rather than as a total of two, which the old comma form could not settle

cases.name: every term at once, in column order
cases.why: the order is FOOTNOTE_COLUMNS and not the order they happen to appear on the board

cases.name: nothing happened
cases.why: nine boards in ten look like this; a term that did not happen is not printed

cases.name: left on base is zero and still printed
cases.why: LOB is a given the global identity needs; absent it reads as unknown rather than as none
